t: You're looking at a statue of Lancelot Brown, better known as Capability Brown, in Hammersmith. Brown was an English gardener and landscape architect, and a notable figure in the history of the English landscape garden style. The statue is the work of the sculptor Laury Dizengremel. Her other work in London includes a statue of Virginia Woolf, which looks out over the Thames at Richmond Riverside and was put up in November 2022. I don't have more detail about this particular statue, so I'll leave it there and let you take in the figure itself.
